top_signals.title: China Has Capacity, But Maybe Not the Will to Boost Fuel Exports
top_signals.summary: China has the greatest ability to boost global fuel supplies after it agreed with the US and Russia to do so, although whether Beijing will follow through on the pledge is doubtful.
